title: Easy Crispy Japanese Tofu Steak 豆腐のステーキ - Chopstick Chronicles
ldName: Easy Crispy Japanese Tofu Steak 豆腐のステーキ
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 bunch bok choy (or any of your favourite veggies)
ldInstructionsRaw: Wrap the tofu in a paper towel and place it on a plate with another plate on top of the tofu to drain the excess water. Leave for about 10 minutes.
In the meantime, wash the bok choy and cook it in boiling water for about 2-3 minutes.
Drain the bok choy and serve it on a plate with the brown rice.
Heat the oil in a pan on high heat and cook the tofu until browned on both sides.
Combine the soy sauce and mirin in a small mixing bowl.
Pour the sauce over the tofu in the pan until the sauce has reduced/evaporated a little.
Serve the tofu on top of the rice and bok choy and drizzle the extra sauce on top.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 1 bunch bok choy or any of your favourite veggies
